isolatedBenchmark.pairedOrder: Seven alternating before/after pairs using actual passes and reused instance streams
isolatedBenchmark.scope: A small dead-work removal. Effects are empty for these non-aircraft vehicles; their benchmark primarily measures avoided preparation. Body tessellation, general vertex allocation, GPU upload, physics and visual detail remain unchanged. These totals are not per-frame live time or an FPS/GC improvement claim.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Private scalar builder plus direct pack regressed complete compile+pack for ordinary bodies. Its small V8 large-body win was noisy and Bun/JSC regressed; global push interception also exposed a private-array trust leak. Candidate was fully removed; existing public mesh ownership/iterator behavior is retained.
rejectedAlternatives.publicVertexFastPath: Descriptor-safe guards increased sampled allocations and slowed actual complete body generation. An unsafe shortcut changed valid accessor/iterator behavior. Production vertex method remains unchanged.
